Messages.Author: Tommy Engvik
Messages.Body:
When Chas Giovanni (If I can recall correctly) attempts to perform an
action, you can burn a master card as a master out-of-turn to "cause
that action to fail".

When a friend of mine played with Chas today, he claimed that Chas
would be untapped if someone burned a master card. Is this so? Why?

Messages.Author: GreySeer
Messages.Body:
"Tommy Engvik" <to...@tragisk.com> wrote in message
news:27eca42e.02011...@posting.google.com...


The action not cancelled ( which would make him untap ) it's fails, in the
same way that it would fail if it was blocked it's just that combat doesn't
occur.

Messages.Author: LSJ
Messages.Body:


Correct. Chas doesn't untap, since no card text indicates that he should.
